scope: Invariant and single-tap review only; geometry reviewed separately by parent. No build, SDK, Native or device operations.
controlFlow: Publicly selected Components returns without a tap only after observe has validated unique canonical role, enabled state and finite48-point frame.
False selection requires fully visible, hittable re-observation, executes one tap and then either returns a freshly observed selected control or throws.
No loop continuation or retry follows the tap; missing/ambiguous post-tap targets terminate.
Search returns the re-observed control without tapping; the existing text mechanism remains unchanged.
Missing header permits bounded short backward scrolling; an observed below-viewport frame fails the backward-only branch.
limits: Source-only reasoning. No runtime selection or focus claim.
No review of the full geometric model or its test execution.
